name: [UPD] Chipotle Burrito Builder
desc:
Welcome to Chipotle Burrito Builder. Teleport back to the original Chipotle location in 1993, the year the Chipotle burrito was born. Use your skills to build and roll burritos like a true Chipotle crew member.

🚨UPDATE🚨
Open CARD PACKS to unlock rewards, open all 53 for a free ENTREE or UGC Avatar Item from Chipotle!
🎟️ENTER the Cinema!
📷WATCH our NEW FILM!

The chance of receiving any card is equal.
Burrito Bucks available in the Chipotle Burrito Builder experience have no monetary value and do not constitute currency or property of any type.
